verdict.rationale: A public OpenAPI spec is served at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, and a community commenter describes calling CodeRabbit's API to generate a patch, so some programmatic surface exists. Configuration is also manageable as code via .coderabbit.yaml, and reviews can be driven through the CLI and @coderabbitai commands, but nothing shows the API matches what the UI can do. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of UI features such as Triage queue actions, Change Stack review/merge, dashboard metrics, learnings and Finishing Touches; an explicit API-parity statement; hands-on corroboration of API breadth.
